name: @pipeworx/mcp-treasury-fiscal

tools.name: treasury_customs_revenue
tools.description: Track monthly US customs duty revenue. Returns monthly collection amounts to analyze tariff impact trends.

limit.description: Number of monthly records to return (default 12 for 1 year)

tools.name: treasury_receipts
tools.description: Get US government receipts by source: individual income tax, corporate tax, excise taxes, customs duties, and more.

tools.name: treasury_debt
tools.description: Check current US national debt with historical data points. Returns total public debt outstanding over time.

tools.name: treasury_exchange_rates
tools.description: Get official US Treasury exchange rates used for government currency conversions. Pass a country name for one country's rate; omit it for the most recent rates across all countries.

country.description: Country name (e.g., "China", "Mexico", "Japan", "Canada"). Treasury indexes by country, not currency: the euro is "Euro Zone" (common aliases like "Eurozone"/"EUR" are accepted), and there is no United States row because these are rates from the dollar. Omit for the latest rates across all countries.

tools.name: treasury_avg_interest_rates
tools.description: Average interest rates on US Treasury securities by security type (bills, notes, bonds, TIPS, total marketable / non-marketable) from the Treasury Fiscal Data avg_interest_rates dataset. Returns recent monthly records.

tools.name: treasury_federal_net_cost
tools.description: US federal government net cost / spending by agency (gross cost, earned revenue, net cost) from the Treasury statement_net_cost dataset. Returns recent records; optionally filter by fiscal_year.

fiscal_year.description: Four-digit fiscal year to filter by (e.g., "2024"). Omit for most recent.

tools.name: treasury_outlays
tools.description: US federal outlays by budget function (Net Interest, National Defense, Social Security, Medicare, Health, ...) plus total net outlays, total receipts and the deficit, from the U.S. Treasury Monthly Treasury Statement. Every row carries current-month, fiscal-year-to-date and prior-year-to-date dollars, the statement date it came from, and its basis (net outlays, nominal dollars, fiscal year Oct-Sep). Use for "net interest outlays FY2026", "federal spending on defense through August", "total outlays and deficit". Covers fiscal years 2015 onward; earlier years or statements not yet released return found:false with the reason, never an empty list. Omit fiscal_year/month for the latest statement.

fiscal_year.description: Federal fiscal year (Oct-Sep), e.g. 2026 = Oct 2025 through Sep 2026. With no month, returns the fiscal-year-end (September) statement, or the latest statement released in that year if it is not over.

month.description: Calendar month of the statement: 1-12 or a name ("September"). With fiscal_year picks that month of that fiscal year; alone picks the most recent such month published.

function.description: Budget function to return, e.g. "Net Interest", "National Defense", "Medicare". Case-insensitive substring match. Omit for all functions.

tools.name: treasury_auction_results
tools.description: US Treasury auction results: high yield/rate, bid-to-cover ratio, and offering/accepted amounts for recently settled bills, notes, bonds, TIPS, and floating-rate notes (FRNs), with CUSIP, from the Treasury Fiscal Data auctions dataset. A reopening (e.g. a "9-Year 10-Month" auction reopening an original 10-year note) is matched by its ORIGINAL nominal term, so term:"10-Year" finds both new 10-year note auctions and reopenings of one. Only settled auctions (with a published rate) are returned; upcoming announced-but-unsettled auctions are excluded.

security_type.description: Security category: "Bill", "Note", "Bond", "TIPS", or "FRN" (floating-rate note). Omit for the most recent settled auctions across all types.

term.description: Original nominal term, e.g. "4-Week", "13-Week", "26-Week", "52-Week" (bills); "2-Year", "3-Year", "5-Year", "7-Year", "10-Year" (notes); "20-Year", "30-Year" (bonds/TIPS). Matched against the security's ORIGINAL term, so it still finds reopenings labeled with a shorter remaining term. Omit for all terms.

limit.description: Number of auctions to return (default 10, max 50)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-treasury-fiscal forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the treasury-fiscal pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
